recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Any remaining work should be handled through separate issue-specific review of individual resources that need Device as an allowed participant or actor type, not by changing the Practitioner guidance for FHIR-35810.
issue_request: FHIR-35810 was an Applied FHIR-core Practitioner change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking how to model AI/ML agents or other machine practitioners. The accepted resolution was to update the Practitioner Boundaries and Relationships section to clarify that autonomous systems and machines should use Device.
initial_application: Commit 85f02ebfed30126b59a6f0a2bd7f5fb4f07db19d, 'FHIR-35810 Machine Practitioner - Provide guidance to use Device not Practitioner,' added the current paragraph to source/practitioner/practitioner-introduction.xml. source/fhir.ini has an active [resources] entry practitioner=Practitioner, so this narrative is in current build scope.
additional_context: The current source preserves the accepted resolution. PA, PC, and O&O discussion in May 2023 and the Implementers Zulip thread converged on Device for AI/autonomous systems. FHIR-40568 was later rejected as no-change after discussion of the same AI-as-Device concern, and FHIR-20511 is related older per-resource work that added Device as an Encounter participant actor.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Practitioner narrative already satisfies FHIR-35810, PractitionerRole did not require a separate edit under the final resolution, and current source searches found no conflicting Practitioner guidance.
